lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gills, with roughly equidistant spacing along horizontal rows in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular spots, forming distinct anchor nodes aligned with the vertical columns of the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges traversing the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, predominantly near the base and anterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral region and lower flank near the pectoral fin.
